title: Arrest of supervisor and $100 million abuse lawsuit at the facility
place_text: Baker Victory Services, Western New York

tellings.quote: to find, right? I think like the supervisor was arrested like 210 felonies, I think the news article reads, for uh like article manipulation and record manipulation. Um there's a $100 million lawsuit that got settled due to just this huge uh claim of sexual abuse over the years.
It has been sued so many times uh not by myself but just by other people reporting sexual abuse claims that they had to close the facility.
tellings.difference: Adds that the lawsuits forced the facility to close, and omits the supervisor's arrest and the $100 million settlement.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of Baker Victory Services being sued repeatedly over sexual abuse claims.

as_told.title: Baker Victory Services closed after abuse lawsuits

plain: Jordan Jose is a man who says he was taken into a secret UFO programme as a child. Speaking with the podcast host Jesse Michels, he talks about a care facility called Baker Victory Services in Western New York, which he links to his story. He says a news article reports that a supervisor there was arrested on about 210 felony charges for altering records. He also says a $100 million lawsuit was settled over many years of sexual abuse claims. He raises this because, if true, it would show the place had something to hide. Later in the same interview he says the facility was sued so many times by other people, not by him, that it had to close. In that version he does not mention the arrest or the settlement.
